name: Institute for the Study of War (ISW)
desc: Daily Russian Offensive Campaign Assessments with control-of-terrain maps; the benchmark analytical product.

name: DeepStateMap
desc: Volunteer-run interactive OSINT frontline map updated continuously; village-level control and artillery ranges.

name: Liveuamap
desc: Live Universal Awareness Map plotting near-real-time conflict events from many sources on an interactive map.

name: Oryx
desc: Visually-confirmed equipment loss database (tanks, IFVs, aircraft) with photo/video proof for both sides.

name: Bellingcat
desc: Investigative OSINT collective; geolocation, satellite imagery and war-crimes verification investigations.

name: Conflict Intelligence Team (CIT)
desc: Independent OSINT/HUMINT team publishing daily sitreps on Russian military activity in Ukraine.

name: GeoConfirmed
desc: Volunteer geolocation/verification platform; 50,000+ verified Ukraine media points on an interactive map.

name: War Mapper
desc: Tracks confirmed territorial control changes with weekly updates and monthly control charts.

name: Ukraine Control Map (Project Owl)
desc: Project Owl OSINT map of geolocations, frontlines, control and unit positions, updated continuously.

name: MilitaryLand.net Deployment Map
desc: Interactive deployment map of Ukrainian and Russian units plus order-of-battle database from open sources.

name: Rochan Consulting - Ukraine Conflict Monitor
desc: Konrad Muzyka's weekly defence-analyst monitor with frontline map, order of battle and 7-day forecasts.

name: Frontelligence Insight
desc: Tatarigami_UA's OSINT reporting using satellite imagery and geolocation; in-depth frontline analysis.

name: OSINTtechnical
desc: High-signal OSINT account sharing verified footage and analysis of Russian and Ukrainian military activity.

name: Ukraine Weapons Tracker
desc: Identifies and catalogs weapons appearing on all sides of the war from photo and video evidence.

name: Centre for Information Resilience - Eyes on Russia
desc: Verified database/map of 29,000+ media points on Russia's invasion, built with Bellingcat and GeoConfirmed.

name: ACLED - Ukraine Conflict Monitor
desc: Near-real-time interactive map and curated dataset of political-violence events with weekly situation updates.

name: Black Bird Group
desc: Finland-based OSINT collective (Emil Kastehelmi) producing maps and frontline analysis from open sources.

name: Suriyak Maps
desc: Detailed interactive Google-Maps frontline maps of the Russo-Ukrainian war and other conflicts.

name: Henry Schlottman
desc: Ex-US Army analyst mapping Russian/Ukrainian units in NATO symbology with regular situational assessments.

name: The Kyiv Independent
desc: Leading English-language Ukrainian newsroom with continuous war coverage and front-line reporting.
